## Notes

Oxymoron Games (Czech), 2018-10-30, Windows/macOS/Linux; build and run a hospital with accurate medical procedures; DLCs: Doctor Mode (2019, control individual doctors), Hospital Services (2020, staff training, cafeterias), Infectious Diseases (2020), Traumatology (2020).
